faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulbaseer?
faq.a: The name is Arabic and is a compound of عبد and a second element.
Yes. The underlying compound is عَبْدُ الْبَصِير (ʿAbd al-Baṣīr).

faq.q: What is the root of Abdulbaseer?
faq.a: عبد is related to ع ب د; al-Baṣīr is related to ب ص ر (b-ṣ-r).
Abdulbaseer is a traditional Muslim personal name because it contains a compound invoking al-Baṣīr, a divine epithet in Islamic tradition.
This record does not establish Abdulbaseer as an explicitly named Qur'anic person; the compound's religious meaning is distinct from personal-name attestation in the text.
